info.description:
This document outlines the API collection used to manage the PHP Radius Client Portal. The API provides a set of endpoints that facilitate communication between your application and the Radius server.

To utilize this API, ensure that you replace the base URL [https://devs1.phpradius.com](https://devs1.phpradius.com) with your specific client portal URL. This will allow you to access the necessary resources and functionalities tailored to your environment.

item.description:
The login page allows users to securely access the client portal and utilize all available features and functionalities. By entering their credentials, users can authenticate themselves and gain entry to the platform.

Upon successful login, the API responds with an authorization `token`, which serves as a `Bearer Token` for subsequent API requests. This token must be included in the header of all required API calls to ensure secure access and maintain user session integrity throughout their interaction with the portal.

## Endpoint

`GET /api/userDetail`

## Description

Retrieves detailed information about the authenticated user including account details, plan information, and personal information.

## Authentication

- **Type**: Bearer Token
- **Header**: `Authorization: Bearer {token}`
- **Note**: Requires valid authentication token from login
    

## Request

- **Method**: GET
- **URL**: `https://devs1.phpradius.com/index.php/api/userDetail`
    

## Response

**Status Code**: 201 Created  
**Content-Type**: application/json

### Successful Response Example

``` json
{
    "data": {
        "id": 27,
        "username": "admin",
        "planName": "10 gb",
        "status": 0,
        "startDate": "2025-06-08 18:30:00",
        "expiryDate": "2025-07-08 18:30:00",
        "userinfo": {
            "contactPerson": "pritesh patel",
            "company": "syv solution",
            "phone": "+917046727299",
            "email": "phpphp666@gmail.com,phpphp33666@gmail.com",
            "billingAddress1": "nomani bazar, nr:meghdoot cinema,mahuva",
            "billingCity": "mahuva",
            "billingZip": "364290"
        },
        "documents": []
    }
}

 ```

### Response Fields Explanation

#### Account Information

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| id | integer | Unique user ID |
| username | string | Login username |
| planName | string | Current plan name |
| status | integer | Account status (0=inactive, 1=active) |
| startDate | datetime | Plan start date |
| expiryDate | datetime | Plan expiry date |

#### User Personal Information (userinfo object)

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| contactPerson | string | Full name of user |
| company | string | Company name |
| phone | string | Primary contact number |
| email | string | Email address(es) |
| billingAddress1 | string | Primary billing address |
| billingCity | string | Billing city |
| billingZip | string | Billing ZIP code |

#### Additional Notes

- `documents` array would contain any uploaded documents if available
- Some fields may be null if not set for the user
    

## Error Responses

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 401 Unauthorized | Invalid or missing authentication token |
| 403 Forbidden | Insufficient permissions |

This API is used to reset a user’s portal password by username. The user must enter their username to initiate the reset request.

After the request is submitted:

- A password reset link is generated and sent to the user’s registered email address.
    
- If the email is sent successfully, the API returns a success message.
    
- If the email cannot be sent (or the request fails), the API returns an error message.
